root_cause.text: The `dwcmshc_rk3568_set_clock` function in the `sdhci-of-dwcmshc` driver fails to validate that the clock frequency remains at least 52MHz when the MMC interface is configured for HS200 or HS400 timing modes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a conditional check `if (host->mmc->ios.timing == MMC_TIMING_MMC_HS200 || host->mmc->ios.timing == MMC_TIMING_MMC_HS400)` within the `dwcmshc_rk3568_set_clock` function to reject clock reductions below 52MHz, addressing the CVE description where setting the clock to 50MHz in these modes caused CQE recovery failures and link breakage.
